extraction.Name: Alice Craven
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent to her 320 acre allotment at the time it was issued, but she was told that if she did not take it, and pay the taxes, that she would lose the land, and she was advised to take it by the Indian Agency; so she accepted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold her land to the Brown Cattle Company, of Sherridan, Wyoming, in 1919, for $5000.00 cash
extraction.Buyer: Brown Cattle Company, of Sherridan, Wyoming, for $5000.00 cash
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: she never paid taxes on this place, nor was she presented with a tax bill
extraction.Occupation/Income: only source of income is by working in the harvest fields in the summer and fall; and that she is now working in the corn fields, near Rushville, Nebraska
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, health good; has three small children she supports in the summer time, and in the winter they go to Rapid City Indian School; she is separated from husband; has never received any help from the County, State or United States Government; affidavit sworn November 24, 1928 | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Pine Ridge (Shannon County, South Dakota)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')

recovery_notes.rationale: Pine Ridge tribe field had 40+ string variants across the corpus. Consolidating to canonical 'Pine Ridge' for clean tabulation while preserving original variant in NOTES for audit.
